finish: CFS indicated at surface-texture symbol; adjacent marking appears to be H. No reliably readable numerical roughness requirement.
general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2 PLACE DIM. ±.02; 3 PLACE DIM. ±.010; ANGULAR DIM. ±1°.

views.description: Longitudinal elevation of cylindrical tie rod, shortened by a conventional central break. Shows a reduced annular neck near each end, full-diameter end collars, and two longitudinal edges consistent with a longitudinal keyway. The two portions separated by the break are one view, not two parts.
views.centerline_notes: Longitudinal centerline identifies the common shaft and neck axis. MACHINE CENTERS PERMITTED is an allowance, not a dimensioned hole requirement.

views.description: End elevation placed to the left of the main elevation in third-angle projection. Shows outer circular outline, end corner treatment, hidden reduced-neck circle, and a small rectangular keyway-like profile at the right side. Keyway visibility/extent and datum attachment require confirmation.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal and vertical centerlines intersect at the shaft axis. The .500 CNT. notation appears to center the keyway width on the horizontal diametral plane. Datum A is marked beside this detail, but its exact attachment is not sufficiently clear.

dimensions.notes: Overall end-to-end length; general two-place tolerance.
From left collar's inboard shoulder to right collar's inboard shoulder. General three-place tolerance.
From left end to first neck shoulder. Not explicitly marked TYP.
TYP; applies to both annular necks. General three-place tolerance.
Leader/dimension spans the reduced neck at the left end. Matching right neck is interpreted as the same diameter; diameter itself is not explicitly marked TYP.
Printed 2.4985 ±.0015 diameter REF. Reference limits 2.4970–2.5000; do not convert into a controlling manufacturing requirement.
Printed .06 C/R BOTH ENDS, interpreted as corner radius. General two-place tolerance.

Printed .500 +.002/-.000 CNT. Numeric reading is clear; interpreted as centered keyway width. Datum A is adjacent, but whether it identifies the slot median plane or a specific surface needs verification.

Horizontal dimension from leftmost outer surface to the vertical line at the right-side keyway floor. General three-place tolerance. Feature interpretation should be verified against original drawing.
.125 R MAX TYP. This is an upper bound, not a nominal radius with ±.010 tolerance; applies to indicated neck-root transitions.
Frame reads perpendicularity | A | .002 in the older notation used on this drawing. The left shoulder is also identified as datum B. No diameter symbol or material modifier is shown.
Upper row of right shoulder frame: perpendicularity | A | .002.
Lower row of right shoulder frame: parallelism | B | .002.
DERIVED: 75.125 - 1.016 - 1.016 = 73.093. This is the shoulder-to-shoulder central body length, not an independently printed keyway length. Use as keyway length only after confirming its termination.
DERIVED: reference diameter 2.4985 - floor distance 2.218 = .2805. Conditional on keyway interpretation and actual stock diameter; not an independent controlling dimension.
DERIVED: 76.88 - 75.125 - .88 = .875. Do not silently enforce exact axial mirror symmetry.
DERIVED instance of D004's explicitly printed TYP requirement; included to close the axial dimension chain.

features.description: Base cylindrical stock, nominal reference diameter 2.4985 and length 76.88. Use a circular sketch on a plane normal to the longitudinal shaft axis.
Left annular neck: remove material down to diameter 1.734 over axial width 1.016 beginning .88 from the left end. Its collar-side shoulder is datum B and has .002 perpendicularity to A.

Right annular neck, interpreted as matching the left neck diameter and TYP width. Its collar-side shoulder is 75.125 from datum-B shoulder, with .002 perpendicularity to A and .002 parallelism to B. Derived right collar length .875.

Interpreted longitudinal centered keyway, width .500 +.002/-.000 and floor 2.218 from the opposite cylindrical extreme. Long edges are shown over the central body. Confirm exact axial extent, termination shape, and datum A attachment before building this feature.
Typical annular neck root rounds, radius no greater than .125. Exact modeling radius is not specified.
.06 corner radius at both outer circular end edges, interpreting the C/R callout as corner radius.

symmetry.plane: Longitudinal plane through shaft axis and keyway center
symmetry.description: Circular shaft and necks are rotationally symmetric; interpreted centered keyway retains this longitudinal mirror plane. End-to-end exact symmetry is not assumed.

concentric_groups.description: Full-diameter stock and both reduced necks share the longitudinal centerline.

dimension_chains.description: Overall length = left end collar + spacing between collar inboard shoulders + right end collar: .88 + 75.125 + .875 = 76.88.
Collar shoulder spacing = left neck + central body + right neck: 1.016 + 73.093 + 1.016 = 75.125.
Conditional keyway radial chain: 2.218 + .2805 = reference diameter 2.4985. Depends on stock reference diameter and keyway interpretation.

warnings: No explicit ASME/ISO/DIN standard designation is visible. Inch units and third-angle projection are explicitly stated; older US-style GD&T frames are present.

The end detail strongly suggests a longitudinal keyway, but exact visibility, axial termination, and datum A attachment should be checked against the original drawing before modeling or inspection. Do not assume datum A is the shaft axis.
Datum B is the left collar's inboard shoulder. The two perpendicularity frames control different shoulders; they are not duplicate requirements on one surface.
The .500 dimension and its +.002/-.000 tolerance are readable. CNT. is interpreted as centered; confirm this abbreviation.
The main diameter is explicitly REF despite having ±.0015 printed. A controlling stock specification should be confirmed before manufacturing.
The right reduced-neck diameter is inferred to match the left; only the neck width and root-radius callouts explicitly say TYP.

Exact axial mirror symmetry would give two .8775 collars; using two nominal .88 collars gives 76.885 overall, .005 above the printed 76.88 but within its general tolerance. Extraction instead preserves the printed chain and derives right collar .875.
The .125 R MAX callout permits a range of root radii and does not determine a unique fillet for an exact CAD model.
MACHINE CENTERS PERMITTED does not specify mandatory center holes, diameters, angles, or depths. No holes have been invented.
CFS likely denotes cold-finished steel; the adjacent H-like surface-symbol marking does not supply a reliably interpretable numerical roughness value.
Title block also lists MODEL No. 120ME, date 10-23-78, sheet size C, sheet 1 of 1, Manufacturing Technology Inc. Tool number is used as the part number. No revision is entered.
